purpose: Design demonstration: bring trade-imports-ins-frontend into the same shape as the two journey frontends (animals, plants) without extracting a shared package, and backport the chassis hardening ins already has. Lands on one branch across every repo it touches, behind draft PRs that are never merged.
direction: ins moves toward animals/plants. Where animals and plants differ from each other, plants is the tidier fork; prefer its shape and say so. Journey-only layers (model, bridge, engine, flow, analysis, sets, obligation-purity, the L3/L4 dependency-cruiser rules) are never ported to ins.
invariants: Public URL surface of ins does not change: /, /address-book, /address-book/add, /address-book/{id}, /address-book/{id}/edit, /address-book/{id}/delete, /auth/*, /signout, /health. Other services and the tests repo link to these.
Behaviour is preserved unless the stage brief says otherwise. A stage that changes behaviour names the change in its notes.
The unit suite, lint, format:check and the Playwright suite are green at the end of every stage, because every stage is a commit on a shared branch that CI checks.
No new shared package, no cross-repo imports. Duplication is deliberate; alignment is the goal.
Every user-facing string that a stage touches or creates lives in copy.en.js and copy.cy.js with identical structure, once stage s07 exists. Before s07, strings stay where they are.
Comments are removed aggressively; no migration or rename comments; git history and app/docs carry the rationale.
Names are explicit and say what a thing does. No metaphors.
Mock at the network boundary (nock) in ins tests; do not introduce module-boundary mocks where a network mock exists.
targetTree: src/auth/* (unchanged) | src/plugins/{auth,csrf}.js | src/config/{config.js, nunjucks/} | src/server/{server.js, router.js, auth/, health/, signout/} | src/server/common/{constants/status-codes.js, helpers/{content-security-policy, errors, organisation-id, pulse, redis-client, request-tracing, serve-static-files, start-server, logging/{logger,logger-options,request-logger}, session-cache/{cache-engine,session-cache}}, services/mode.js, test-helpers/{mock-auth-config, mock-oidc-config}} | src/server/app/{routes.js, auth/unauthorised.njk, docs/, lib/{http-status.js, http-client.js, validate/}, services/{address-book,countries,ins-backend}/{index.js, client.js, stub.js}, shared/{copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, copy.js, copy-leaves.js, kit.js, paths.js, layout.njk, error.njk, error-summary.njk}, features/{index.js, dashboard/, address-book/{copy/, fields.js, address-countries.js, list/, add/, edit/, view/, delete/, view-model/, fit/}}} | src/server/copy-convention.test.js | src/server/copy-parity.test.js

stages.title: move the chassis into the animals layout
stages.brief: Pure relocation, no behaviour change. In ins: move src/server/plugins/{content-security-policy,logger-options,pulse,request-logger,request-tracing,serve-static-files,session-cache}.js to the paths animals uses under src/server/common/helpers/ (logging/ for the logger pair, session-cache/ for session-cache.js); move src/server/plugins/{auth,csrf}.js to src/plugins/; move src/server/plugins/router.js to src/server/router.js; move src/server/routes/health to src/server/health; delete src/server/routes/about (a CDP template sample nothing links to). Move each file's test beside it. Update every import. Leave src/server/routes/home and src/server/routes/error where they are for now (s05 moves them). Keep the #/ alias in this stage (s02 removes it).

stages.title: replace the #/ import alias with relative paths
stages.brief: Mechanical. Rewrite every `#/...` import and every `vi.mock('#/...')` in src/ and test-helpers/ to a relative path, exactly as animals does. Remove the `imports` field from package.json. Nothing else changes. The planner should give the implementor the rewrite rule and the file list; this is not a stage that needs per-file review beyond a sample.

stages.title: collapse INS_MODE and AUTH_STUB_MODE into STUB_MODE
stages.brief: Behaviour change, named: ins currently switches data stubs (INS_MODE=stub) and the auth stub (AUTH_STUB_MODE=true) independently; animals has one flag, STUB_MODE, read through isStubMode() in common/services/mode.js, which covers both and is never honoured in production. Give ins the animals mode.js verbatim and the animals config.js `stubMode` entry (keep ins's strict-boolean convict format and apply it to stubMode). Replace isAuthStubMode() and isRealMode() call sites. Update playwright.config.js webServer env, vitest.config.js (env STUB_MODE=true like animals), the CI workflow comment, README, compose.yml and any .env example. The workspace stack sets neither variable for ins, so it needs no change. Record in notes that the split was the better design and was given up for parity, so the report can say so.

stages.title: reshape the clients into app/services
stages.brief: Create src/server/app/ and src/server/app/lib/. Move src/server/common/clients/{address-book,countries,ins-backend}-client{,.real,.stub}.js into src/server/app/services/<name>/{index.js, client.js, stub.js}: client.js is the real HTTP client, stub.js the canned data, index.js the public surface that chooses stub or real via isStubMode() exactly as animals' services/countries/index.js does. Move http-client.js to src/server/app/lib/http-client.js. Move the __mocks__ folders so vi.mock resolution still works, or replace them with nock at the network boundary where a test only needs a response. Adopt from the animals address-book client: refuse to build a URL when the organisation id is missing (throw, never call with 'undefined'), and take the trace header from getTraceId() rather than a parameter. Keep ins's CRUD methods. Keep mapApiErrorsToFormErrors exported from the service. Update every import.

stages.title: add app/shared, app/routes.js and the dashboard feature
stages.brief: Give ins the L1 shape without any journey machinery. Create src/server/app/shared/{kit.js, paths.js, error.njk, error-summary.njk, layout.njk} and src/server/app/lib/http-status.js from the animals files, keeping ONLY the journey-free parts of kit.js: base() (layout, pageTitle, backLink, recoverableError, sharedCopy-ready but sharedCopy can be an empty object until s07), errorSummary(), fieldError(), pageRoutes(path, {get, post}) adapted so a feature passes its own path builder from paths.js, and recoverableSave(). paths.js exports dashboardPath(), addressBookPath(), addressPath(id), addressEditPath(id), addressDeletePath(id), addressAddPath() and the matching route-path forms. Create src/server/app/routes.js exporting one Hapi plugin (name it for the service) that registers features/index.js's allRoutes and primes countries in real mode, and have src/server/router.js register it in place of the per-page plugins. Move src/server/routes/home to src/server/app/features/dashboard/{controller.js, template.njk, fit/} with the controller exporting `routes` via kit.pageRoutes; move notification-dashboard-helper.js and pagination-helper.js into features/dashboard/view-model/. Move src/server/routes/error/index.njk to app/shared/error.njk rendered by errors.js through base(). Move src/server/auth/unauthorised.njk to src/server/app/auth/unauthorised.njk. Move common/templates/layouts/page.njk to app/shared/layout.njk unchanged in content (s09 restyles it) and point every template at it. Change the Nunjucks roots in src/config/nunjucks/nunjucks.js to src/server/app and src/server/app/features, mirroring animals' app + app/sets pair, and update view names. Rename common/helpers/require-organisation-id.js to common/helpers/organisation-id.js exporting organisationIdOf() as animals does, and keep the Boom.forbidden as a kit-level requireOrganisationId() that calls it. Delete src/server/routes/ once empty. The address-book folder stays where it is until s06 but must keep working.

stages.title: move the address book into app/features with the group anatomy
stages.brief: Move src/server/address-book to src/server/app/features/address-book and give it the multi-page group shape plants' commodities feature has: list/, add/, edit/, view/, delete/ each holding controller.js and template.njk (rename index.njk to template.njk); each controller exports `routes` built with kit.pageRoutes and the path builders from shared/paths.js, and the per-page index.js plugins go away; features/index.js spreads them into allRoutes. address-schema.js becomes fields.js (field names, limits and the schema builder stay together until s08 replaces joi). address-countries.js and address-id-params.js stay in the feature root. Move common/helpers/address-book-helper.js into features/address-book/view-model/ (rows, results label, pagination links) and common/constants/session-keys.js into the feature. The fit/ folder stays inside the feature; update playwright.config.js testDir to src/server/app/features so both features' specs run. Keep the shared-form fixture pattern the fit specs already use.

stages.title: move every string into copy.en.js and copy.cy.js pairs
stages.brief: Port from animals: app/shared/copy.js (copyFor), copy-leaves.js, copy.en.js and copy.cy.js for the shared layout, error summary, footer and error page strings; src/server/copy-convention.test.js and copy-parity.test.js adapted to ins's feature root. Then give features/dashboard and features/address-book a copy/{copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, copy.test.js} each and move every string out of controllers and templates into them: page titles, headings, labels, hints, button text, validation messages, success banners, empty-state text, table headers. The Welsh is machine-drafted: write it, keep the structure identical, and record in notes that a translator must review it before any real release. Templates read copy through the view model exactly as plants' origin template does.

stages.title: replace joi with app/lib/validate
stages.brief: Port src/server/app/lib/validate/{index.js, run.js, validators.js, calendar.js} and their tests from animals. Rewrite the address form validation in features/address-book/fields.js with compose(), requiredMaxText(), maxText(), requiredOneOf() for the country and pattern() for the email, messages coming from the feature's copy. Errors flow as { field: message } into kit.errorSummary() and kit.fieldError(), so common/helpers/validation-helpers.js goes and mapApiErrorsToFormErrors in the address-book service returns the same { field: message } shape. Remove joi from package.json and refresh the lockfile with the repo's own npm. Every validation message the fit specs assert must still appear verbatim.

stages.title: adopt the Design release 1 layout
stages.brief: Replace app/shared/layout.njk with the animals layout: govukServiceNavigation with dashboard, address book, manage account and log out; phase banner; back link driven by base(); no breadcrumbs; sharedCopy-driven strings; the app-journey-strip block may stay since it renders nothing without a journey. Point the address-book navigation item at addressBookPath() and the dashboard at dashboardPath(). Delete common/components/heading and common/components/service-header and their SCSS, replacing appHeading with the govuk-heading classes the animals templates use. Port activeNavigationItem() into src/config/nunjucks/context/context.js from animals, dropping build-navigation.js and breadcrumbs from the context. Port the animals client stylesheet scaffold where ins differs (core/_header.scss, helpers). Every fit spec that asserts heading or navigation text must still pass.

stages.title: align the build and dev tooling
stages.brief: Move ins from vite to webpack: port webpack.config.js, postcss.config.js and babel.config.cjs from animals, the build:frontend and frontend:watch scripts, the assets-manifest.json read in context.js, the getAssetPath('application.js') and getAssetPath('stylesheets/application.scss') keys in the layout, and the matching devDependencies; drop vite and src/client/assets.html; refresh the lockfile. Add the packageManager pin (npm@11.6.2, as animals and plants), scripts/npm-version.js, the Dockerfile npm install steps and the CI workflow step that aligns npm before npm ci, copying plants' check-pull-request.yml for that step; regenerate package-lock.json under the pinned npm. Add dependency-cruiser with a reduced .dependency-cruiser.cjs: features never import a sibling feature, only app/routes.js imports features/, shared/ and lib/ import nothing from features/ or services/, no circular dependencies; add lint:arch to lint. Add scripts/check-workspace-stack.js and the check:workspace-stack script. Split Playwright into a root fit/ smoke project and a features project over src/server/app/features/**/*.fit.spec.js, with test:fit:features and test:fit:ci as animals has them. Skip Lighthouse in this stage and record it as an open question.

stages.title: write app/docs and the feature recipes for ins
stages.brief: Write src/server/app/docs/{README.md, architecture.md, features.md, add-a-page.md, services.md, testing.md} in the voice and shape of the plants set docs, describing the ins layout as it now is: no set, no journey, features one level down at app/features, the page kit, the services shape, the copy pair rule, the fit conventions. add-a-page.md cites features/address-book/add as the minimal complete example. Update README.md to describe the layout and drop the CDP template boilerplate that no longer applies. Add a short docs/reference note in the workspace? No: the workspace is out of scope for this stage.

stages.title: backport the ins chassis hardening to animals and plants
stages.brief: The reverse direction, once, so the three chassis copies agree. Port from ins into BOTH animals and plants, with the tests ins has for each: src/auth/get-safe-redirect.js rejecting protocol-relative, absolute, backslash and CRLF redirects; src/auth/refresh-tokens.js posting a form body instead of a query string; src/plugins/auth.js catching a refresh failure and returning isValid:false, and encoding the redirect target in redirectTo; src/server/auth/controller.js rejecting a sign-in whose profile has no organisationId and surviving a getPermissions failure; the strict-boolean convict format in src/config/config.js applied to stubMode and any other security flag. Keep animals' own sign-out session drop and its stub sign-in path alias. Apply the identical change to both repos so they stay byte-for-byte equal in these files.

stages.title: write the alignment report for the team
stages.brief: Write workareas/shared/frontend-alignment/report.md: the proposal as built. Sections: why (drift in security-sensitive chassis code, three copies), what changed in ins stage by stage with the before and after trees, what was backported the other way, the decisions taken and which were two-against-one calls that the team can reverse (stub-mode collapse, import style, build tool, plugins location, client layout), residual drift after alignment measured by a normalised three-way diff of the chassis files, the Welsh copy caveat, the open questions collected from every stage, and how to keep the three aligned from here (the surfaces manifest and a drift check). Link every draft PR. Plain GitHub markdown.
